# ZPilot Support

## Getting help

Review README.md, docs/, release notes, and existing issues. Use GitHub Discussions for general questions when enabled. Open an issue for reproducible non-sensitive defects.

## Security

Do not report vulnerabilities, credentials, private data, or exploit details in public issues or Discussions. Follow SECURITY.md and use private vulnerability reporting when available.

## Support expectations

ZPilot is an open-source project and does not currently promise a service-level agreement. Support is best-effort through repository issues and pull requests.

## Include

When reporting a problem, include ZPilot version/commit, operating system, Python version, sanitized repository inventory, reproduction steps, expected/actual behavior, and sanitized logs. Remove secrets and personal data.
